items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: I'd see him every once in a while because he always kind of liked me.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's who it was. But after Charlie died he used to come around. I'd see him every once in a while because he always kind of liked me.
Yeah, he used to hang around 8th Avenue quite a bit. I haven't seen him recently.
